principle: Availability, norming and scoring provenance are orthogonal. AVAILABLE never implies NORMED, and an externally or adaptively scored instrument never transfers scientific authority to symbolic methods.

definitions.AVAILABLE: Instrument logic, rights, scoring path, runtime and signal mapping are admitted at this tranche. Customer publication can still be blocked by PRF-W12.
definitions.AVAILABLE_WHEN_CONFIGURED: All PHI OS implementation work is admitted but a provider credential or external configuration is required at deployment.
definitions.NORMED: An exact reference population, transformation and version are admitted for the exact instrument. Norming never transfers between instruments or translations.
definitions.EXTERNALLY_SCORED: The authoritative score is returned by the named external provider. PHI OS may validate and map the result but does not silently reproduce provider scoring.
definitions.ADAPTED_SCORED: PHI OS owns an explicitly adapted scoring rule derived from an admitted source. The result must not be presented as the source organisation's official score.
